corinthians2.12.p1.b1.text: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven.

corinthians2.12.p1.b2.text: was caught up to Paradise. The things he heard were too sacred for words, things that man is not permitted to tell.

corinthians2.12.p1.b3.text: And I know that this man—whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows—

corinthians2.12.p1.b4.text: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.

corinthians2.12.p2.b1.text: So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.

corinthians2.12.p2.b2.text: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.

corinthians2.12.p2.b3.text: My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.

corinthians2.12.p3.b1.text: Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.

corinthians2.12.p3.b2.text: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties.

corinthians2.12.p3.b3.text: For when I am weak, then I am strong.

corinthians2.12.p4.b1.text: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me…

corinthians2.12.p4.b2.text: The true marks of an apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles—were performed among you with great perseverance.

corinthians2.12.p5.b1.text: See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden…

corinthians2.12.p5.b2.text: …children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

corinthians2.12.p5.b3.text: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself.

corinthians2.12.p5.b4.text: …Did Titus exploit you in any way?

corinthians2.12.p6.b1.text: …all of this, beloved, is to build you up.

corinthians2.12.p6.b2.text: For I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I wish, and you may not find me as you wish.

corinthians2.12.p6.b3.text: I am afraid that when I come again, my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved…
